title: Quality report counts the real suite; defect posting type
story: As the PMO I want org/quality.json to reflect npm test and the defect process to match the fabric so that sprint metrics are true
acceptance: node dashboard/quality-report.mjs (no argument) runs the same globs as npm test (package.json scripts.test) instead of passing the tests/ directory, and its counts equal npm test's (test compares the spawned args to package.json)
tests/STRATEGY.md says escaped defects are posted as type blocker (the fabric has no defect type), matching org/playbooks/standards.md v3
brief: Sprint 5 found the report always showed 1 test, 0 passed, because node --test with a directory argument fails on Node 22.
